race.comment: COCO DE LUXE (2) appreciated the drop in grade last start when a close fifth over 1200m at Wodonga. Fitter for two runs back from a spell and with a bit of weight relief today she looks ready to win. BIFURCATION (5) scored on a soft track over 1200m at Corowa two back then extended to 1400m last start and struggled to get involved. Nicely in after the claim and the return to this trip should see a form rebound. TERESPRIT (8) has been racing well save for a failure in a Randwick Highway two back. Placed at five of ten runs over this distance and she likes the sting out of the ground. YOU WISH (7) is a good wet tracker ready to peak after three runs back from a spell.
